type Profile = Pick<ReasoningConfiguration, 'sourceUrl' | 'basis'> & {
  configurations: Pick<ReasoningConfiguration, 'tier' | 'effort'>[];
};
const reasoningProfiles = profiles as Record<string, Profile>;
const tierLabels = { top: 'Top', middle: 'Middle', lowest: 'Lowest', single: 'Single configuration' };

// Every configuration stays enabled. Incomplete evidence is handled by the existing provisional section.
export const initialModels: ModelRelease[] = modelCatalog.flatMap(model => {
  const profile = reasoningProfiles[model.id];
  return profile.configurations.map(config => ({
    ...model,
    id: config.tier === 'top' || config.tier === 'single' ? model.id : `${model.id}--${String(config.effort)}`,
    name: `${model.name} — ${tierLabels[config.tier]}`,
    shortName: `${model.shortName} — ${tierLabels[config.tier]}`,
    reasoningConfiguration: { ...config, releaseId: model.id, sourceUrl: profile.sourceUrl, basis: profile.basis }
  }));
});
